title: Sir Humphrey Gilbert
author: James Baldwin
summary: 汉弗莱·吉尔伯特爵士在海上风暴中鼓励同伴，最终与船员一同遇难。
publicDomainBasis: Published 1896 by the American Book Company; author James Baldwin (1841–1925). Public domain in the United States and in China (author's life plus 70 years).

paragraphs.en: More than three hundred years ago there lived in England a brave man whose name was Sir Humphrey Gilbert. At that time there were no white people in this country of ours. The land was covered with forests; and where there are now great cities and fine farms there were only trees and swamps among which roamed wild Indians and wild beasts.
paragraphs.zh: 三百多年前，英格兰住着一位勇敢的人，名叫汉弗莱·吉尔伯特爵士。那时，我们这片土地上还没有白人。大地覆盖着森林；如今矗立着大城市和良田的地方，当时只有树木和沼泽，野生的印第安人和野兽在其中出没。

paragraphs.en: Sir Humphrey Gilbert was one of the first men who tried to make a settlement in America. Twice did he bring men and ships over the sea, and twice did he fail, and sail back for England. The second time, he was on a little ship called the "Squirrel." Another ship, called the "Golden Hind," was not far away. When they were three days from land, the wind failed, and the ships lay floating on the waves. Then at night the air grew very cold. A breeze sprang up from the east. Great white icebergs came drifting around them. In the morning the little ships were almost lost among the floating mountains of ice. The men on the "Hind" saw Sir Humphrey sitting on the deck of the "Squirrel" with an open book in his hand. He called to them and said,—
paragraphs.zh: 汉弗莱·吉尔伯特爵士是最早尝试在美洲建立定居点的人之一。他两次带着人员和船只渡海，两次都失败了，只好驶回英格兰。第二次，他乘坐一艘叫“松鼠号”的小船，另一艘叫“金鹿号”的船就在不远处。离陆地还有三天航程时，风停了，船只漂在波浪上。到了夜里，空气变得非常寒冷，东风骤起，巨大的白色冰山从四周漂来。第二天早晨，两艘小船几乎消失在漂浮的冰山之间。“金鹿号”上的人看见汉弗莱爵士坐在“松鼠号”甲板上，手里拿着一本打开的书。他朝他们喊道：

paragraphs.en: "Be brave, my friends! We are as near heaven on the sea as on the land."
paragraphs.zh: “勇敢些，朋友们！在海上和在陆地上，我们离天堂一样近。”

paragraphs.en: Night came again. It was a stormy night, with mist and rain. All at once the men on the "Hind" saw the lights on board of the "Squirrel" go out. The little vessel, with brave Sir Humphrey and all his brave men, was swallowed up by the waves.
paragraphs.zh: 夜幕再次降临。那是一个风雨交加、雾气弥漫的夜晚。“金鹿号”上的人忽然看见“松鼠号”上的灯火熄灭了。那艘小船，连同勇敢的汉弗莱爵士和他所有勇敢的同伴，一起被海浪吞没了。
